metadata.datasource: Agfa Datenblatt APX 25, status 08/1995, 1st edition; SHA256 50d77e7ca6c1dfd69803e28d34fd11c622affcf87a1362155d3c0c9ad2046d81. Reproduce with scripts/bw_expansion/prepare_bw_film.py; axis calibration derived from the page by scripts/bw_expansion/extract_graphs.py; source points, assumptions and conditions: data/profile-sources/agfa-apx25/recipe.json. PCHIP of the single plotted log-sensitivity trace; engine covers 380-780 nm. The trace spans 380.6-664.6 nm and meets the panel's -2.0 floor at its red end, so it is truncated at 660 nm; 380 nm is left unmeasured because the trace begins above it. Both are explicit unmeasured-tail approximations, not proof of zero sensitivity. The sheet does not label the density curve with a developer or time. Its average gradient is 0.632 over 1.3 decades and 0.648 over 1.5 decades, measured from the point 0.1 above base. The sheet's own gamma-time curves read 0.644 to 0.651 for all five listed developers at their recommended 20 C times (Refinal 6, Rodinal 1+25 6, Rodinal 1+50 10, Rodinal Special 4, Studional Liquid 4). The curve therefore represents Agfa's recommended development rather than one developer, and 6 minutes is recorded as a representative time, not a measured condition.
